KenEasy WaveForge - Third-Party Notices & Architecture

This product is engineered to be 100% client-side, lightweight, and offline-first.
It uses purely native Web standards:
- Web Audio API (AudioContext, AnalyserNode, OfflineAudioContext)
- HTML5 Canvas 2D Rendering Engine
- MediaStream & MediaRecorder API (Hardware-accelerated client-side video encoding)
- Standard DOM & CSS Glassmorphism Engine

No remote telemetry, external CDNs, tracking cookies, or server-side video transcoding dependencies.
Zero runtime network activity required.
